body: Rollout is 4 hosts x 15 lanes = 60 cells. A cell counts DEPLOYED only when that lane's coordinator answers a nonced LeaderPing on its own mailbox over KernelRealtime within T_resp, AND the observer runs on a DIFFERENT HOST. Same-host observation cannot distinguish a working transport from a loopback-only one, which is exactly today's failure. This makes FR-31 unable to pass while FR-03 fails - the sequencing is enforced by the evidence rule itself rather than by discipline.
evidence: SHIRAS 2026-09-07T08:30Z; derived from the loopback measurement at 06:50Z
title: A deployment cell is proven by a nonced round trip OBSERVED FROM A DIFFERENT HOST

body: T_ping <= 120s is the requirement, not a target. Detection latency is N_miss x T_ping. Stating a grace in absolute seconds independently of T_ping lets the two drift and re-introduces the timer anti-pattern OB-4 retired. RECOMMEND T_ping=120s max, N_miss=3, detection <= 360s, with BOTH values carried as data on the NoConfidence record so a verdict can be read against the policy that produced it. No new type is needed: L0's NoConfidence(Domain,Term,Subject,Watcher,Reason,GraceMisses,PingInterval,ObservedAt) already carries both fields.
title: The 2-minute cadence is a MAXIMUM, and the grace must be derived from it, not stated independently
